summary: Source prop sheet for the Data Analyst stakeholder in the data-architect-product-trio pack. The sheet arranges analytics-themed tools on a plain white background: a tablet or clipboard with a calendar grid, a filter funnel icon, check marks, donut and bar charts, small report pages, a purple lanyard badge with a lightbulb icon, a cream-and-purple pen, and clean cards showing analytics summaries. The style matches the Issue #56 stakeholder prop language: clean vector-adjacent painterly rendering, isolated readable objects, purple and gold accents, and a warm, organized, helpful mood.

composition: Role-specific prop sheet on a clean white or very light background.
The tablet or clipboard is the largest item and anchors the layout.
Supporting papers, cards, a lanyard badge, a pen, charts, and analytics tools are arranged around the tablet.
Each object is isolated, readable, and consistent with the Data Analyst colour palette.
props: Tablet or clipboard showing a calendar-style grid.
Filter funnel icon suggesting filtering and interpretation.
Donut charts and bar charts rendered in purple and gold tones.
Small report pages or analytics summary cards.
Purple lanyard and badge with a lightbulb or insight icon.
style_and_colour: Clean Adventures editorial / vector-adjacent painterly style.
Rounded readable linework and simplified forms.
Purple, lavender, cream, warm brown, and gold/yellow chart accents.
Soft painterly shading and warm lighting.
No real brand logos, realistic UI detail, or tiny pseudo-text.
role_cues: The props collectively signal data interpretation, filtering, and evidence checking.
Calendar grid, filter funnel, check marks, and charts anchor the Data Analyst identity.
The absence of roadmap lanes, feature cards, system diagrams, or architecture blocks distinguishes this role from Product Manager and Software Architect props.

positive_constraints: Treat this image as the Data Analyst prop source for Issue #56 stakeholder assets.
Arrange the tablet/clipboard as the largest prop, with supporting analytics tools around it.
Use the Data Analyst palette: purple, lavender, cream, warm brown, and gold/yellow chart accents.
Keep props simplified but unmistakably data-analytics themed: calendar grid, filter funnel, check marks, donut charts, bar charts, reports, lightbulb badge, cream-and-purple pen.
Maintain the clean white background and isolated, reusable source-asset presentation.
Preserve the warm, organized, patient, and helpful Data Analyst mood.
negative_constraints: Do not add unrelated role props such as roadmap lanes, feature cards, system diagrams, database cylinders, or architecture blueprints.
Do not introduce additional stakeholder characters unless the sheet explicitly includes them.
Do not overload charts or cards with tiny pseudo-text or realistic software UI.
Do not remove the lanyard/badge cue or replace the purple lightbulb badge with a different role's badge icon.
Do not turn the prop sheet into a full scene, environment, or group composition.
Do not introduce other stakeholder colour palettes (olive-brown/blue for software architect, light blue/navy/orange/green for product manager) as dominant accents.

best_for: Data Analyst prop selection and layout reference.
Continuity checks across stakeholder prop sheets.
QA that the props read as data-analytics rather than generic office supplies.
not_sufficient_for: Full Data Analyst character turnaround (use the hero and alternate source images).
Authorizing derivative images without direct image QA.
Exact OCR of any small chart or card text.
